expected.originalText: AO.	whereas the EU’s most recent China strategy dates from 2019; whereas a unified, pragmatic, consistent, comprehensive and principled EU policy towards China is therefore needed to determine the EU’s future in global affairs; whereas such a policy should be based on the current geopolitical situation and therefore have a clear focus on security as well as on the EU’s strategic autonomy and reciprocity;
expected.proposedText: AO.	whereas the EU’s most recent China strategy dates from 2019; whereas a unified, pragmatic, consistent, comprehensive and principled EU policy towards China is therefore needed to determine the EU’s future in global affairs; whereas the EU-China comprehensive strategic partnership should be based on the current geopolitical situation and therefore have a clear focus on the EU’s values, strategic autonomy, interests and priorities, including security;

expected.onBehalfOf: on behalf of the Renew Group
expected.originalText: 1.	Condemns Islamist entryism strategies aimed at weakening democratic institutions, the rule of law, equality between women and men, freedom of conscience, freedom of expression, public order, social cohesion and the values enshrined in Article 2 TEU;
expected.proposedText: 1.	Condemns religious and, in particular, Islamist entryism strategies as an unacceptable form of covert and malicious interference aimed at weakening democratic institutions, the rule of law and the neutrality of public institutions; is concerned by the fact that religious entryism spearheads efforts to roll back women’s rights and gender equality, sexual health and reproductive rights, LGBTIQ+ rights, equality between women and men, freedom of conscience, freedom of expression, public order, social cohesion and the values enshrined in Article 2 TEU;

expected.onBehalfOf: on behalf of the Renew Group
expected.originalText: 3.	Recalls that protecting Muslim citizens against discrimination is a democratic obligation, but that recognising organised Islamist networks as representative interlocutors constitutes a political and institutional failure;
expected.proposedText: 3.	Recalls that protecting Muslim citizens against discrimination is a democratic obligation and condemns any political discourse that distorts the legitimate fight against malicious entryism to fuel racism, xenophobia and anti-Muslim hatred;
